requirement: Each accepted write/bidir segment yields exactly LEN+1 wr pulses and each read/bidir segment exactly LEN+1 rd pulses (pre values at rising edges), attributed in acceptance order; no wr/rd pulse without an accepted command expecting it.
source: registers.md COMMAND.LEN 292-302, COMMAND.DIRECTION 304-307; theory_of_operation 125-140; interface output_aliases wr/rd and sampling rule
assumption: wr/rd each represent one byte; extra pulses beyond the per-segment budget are attributed to the next queued segment of matching direction

requirement: At each wr (rd) pulse, last_write (last_read) is 1 iff it is the final byte of its segment.
assumption: last flag is only constrained when the corresponding handshake pulse is asserted

requirement: During rst_n=0 rows, pre and post csb are all-inactive (3) and no wr/rd pulse occurs; tracked operations are discarded.
source: interface input_aliases rst_n (asynchronous); registers.md CONTROL.SW_RST 120-123 (reset state); theory_of_operation 641-644
assumption: the reset state has all selects deasserted and no handshakes; inferred from 'reset state' wording

requirement: When software reset is held for consecutive cycles without stall indication, from the second cycle pre.csb is all-inactive and no wr/rd occurs; any wr/rd after any reset before a newly accepted command is a stale byte.
source: registers.md CONTROL.SW_RST 120-123; theory_of_operation 641-644; interface sw_reset synchronous
assumption: Reset-over-stall precedence is NOT assumed: a software reset coincident with tx_stall/rx_stall suspends checking and yields unresolved

requirement: While tx_stall or rx_stall is asserted (pre): no wr/rd handshake, no SCK edge, and csb unchanged across the edge.
assumption: stall flags are the public-pin indication of the FSM stall condition

requirement: backpressure_then_recovery counted only when an open in-flight segment (selected) stalls with the matching source/sink not ready, the stall clears without reset, and the segment then completes per P01/P02 with select release or later handshake, sufficient SCK edges and no failures.
assumption: Recovery latency is not bounded; unfinished recovery at trace end is pending
support_status: implemented (event witness only, no liveness bound)

requirement: At most one csb line active; an active line must correspond to the CSID of an open accepted command (or the command accepted at that edge).
assumption: NumCS=2 encoding csb=2 selects index 0, csb=1 selects index 1

requirement: After a completed CSAAT=1 segment, its select must not be released while no later command has been accepted (and no reset).
assumption: completion measured by final byte handshake

requirement: When a command with changed CSID or CONFIGOPTS fields is accepted after a CSAAT segment, the old select is released and an all-inactive gap occurs before the new select; selecting the new CSID; the new segment may not complete without that gap.
assumption: Changed command may be offered/accepted while the previous CSAAT segment is still active (queued offer allowed)

requirement: Within a witnessed switch: trail (last SCK edge to old release) >= (old CSNTRAIL+1)*(old CLKDIV+1); gap >= (new CSNIDLE+1)*(new CLKDIV+1), or max(old,new) idle when configuration changed; lead (new select to first SCK edge) >= (new CSNLEAD+1)*(new CLKDIV+1); core-cycle units, one-cycle tolerance, boundary values unresolved.
assumption: half-SCK = CLKDIV+1 core cycles; additive old+new idle reading reported but not enforced

requirement: With all selects inactive, any SCK edge must move toward the CPOL of the most recently accepted command.
assumption: unchecked after reset until a command is accepted

requirement: abort_then_restart counted separately for sw_reset and async_reset only when a progressed incomplete segment is interrupted, no stale byte occurs, and the next accepted command completes per P01/P02 with release and sufficient SCK edges.

Pending valid and command fields hold until acceptance or reset; no valid during rst_n=0; speed!=3; bidirectional only at std; trace begins with two reset cycles; fields within listed widths. Violations are assumption_violations, not DUT failures.
assumption: acceptance = valid and pre.ready on a non-reset row

requirement: Select of an in-progress segment must not release with bytes outstanding; wr requires tx_ready and rd requires rx_ready in the same row; accept and first handshake may share an edge.
source: registers.md COMMAND.LEN 292-302; interface tx_ready/rx_ready aliases and sampling rule
assumption: ready inputs apply to the edge on which the handshake is sampled
support_status: implemented; last-flag level outside handshakes and active/ready outputs not checked

source: theory_of_operation 366-368 (register STATUS view, not this boundary)
assumption: no bound is specified at this boundary
support_status: unresolved: unfinished operations reported pending, never failed

requirement: Exact SCK edges per byte/lane, CPHA/FULLCYC sample/shift alignment, sd_en and speed/full_cycle outputs.
support_status: not supported: cited text does not fix cycle-exact pin behavior; only a conservative edge-count lower bound is used as completion evidence

requirement: CSNLEAD/CSNTRAIL/CSNIDLE for every select episode outside switches.
support_status: not implemented: episode-to-config attribution ambiguous with queued commands; scoped to switches
